rules.name: arena street lamps
rules.note: 1-4's Arena (V2's room, tour stop 'Arena'; user 2026-11-19: 'way too bright'). Its four lamps stand against the walls, where the lamp garden's settings (gain 4, keep 0.35) floodlit walls and floor: pathtrace at fixed-equivalent exposure (auto exposure held x1.0) read mean 48 against the game's 25, p95 172 against 110, pixels under 16 11 % against 66 %. Gain 2 (the global rule's) and 15 % kept: mean 35.7, p95 109, under 16 19 %; the second view 28.0 -> 20.6 (game 10.8). Run 20261119-233149_arena-diag_alt. Must stay above 'street lamp bulbs' (first match wins).

rules.name: street lamp bulbs
rules.note: 1-4: x3 on the global rule. At the global gain the lamp garden's walls read at p95 x0.62 of the game's (the pools behind the lamps were gone); x4 gave x1.22 and lifted the dark end (+18). 2026-11-18 (user: 'more light pooling on the ground with RT off'): hybrid, 35 % of the light stays for the pool under the lamp (the glass alone lights sideways; its base shadows the ground). Gain 6 -> 4 the same day: with a third of the light back, the glass at x6 lit the fog around each lamp into a ball (user: 'a fake camera-facing bloom sprite'; vol.emissive=0 removes it).
